summary: Liraasa 2.0 (ADR-0016), from the author's patch "Liraasa 2.0: the great lexicon expansion": rulings 2.0:G37–G42 (word-building only; no clause, order or inflection rule changes), 10 roots and 346 compounds, 276 slots activated, 207 glosses edited, 77 lexicalised derivations, 391 template headwords moved into the image-compound pattern.

rulings.ruling: Declare devo / devi and nevi / devi as permitted one-edit pairs.

rulings.topic: Colour bases in compounds; compounds lexicalised with -ti
rulings.ruling: Colour bases may act as the modifier in a dictionary compound, and a compound may be lexicalised with -ti.
aurumijuba and vanajuba become dictionary headwords as well as colour words.
Image compounds: any listed modifier + any listed head is a valid word with a predictable meaning, no 'new' flag needed (see pattern_compounds).

Derivations are fully productive with default readings: R+yo = one who does R, or one devoted to R; R+vu = a big or intense R; R+pago = the place of R; R+ti = a little or dear R. They attach to any root or compound (as lemudonuyo and mambiletoyo already do). Listed derivations keep their fixed meanings and override the default.

A compound may take a compound as one of its two parts: MODIFIER + HEAD still joins exactly two headwords, either of which may itself be a compound (larbopago + safa = larbopagosafa). 1.2 avoided nesting; 2.0 allows it.

image_compounds.name: Image compounds
image_compounds.rule: MODIFIER + HEAD, written as one word, where MODIFIER is any root in 'modifiers' and HEAD any root in 'heads'. Meaning: '<modifier adjective> <head>', that is, <head template> <modifier sense>. Example: luno + savali = lunosavali, 'moonlit kiss; an intimate kiss recalling moonlight'. Every such pair is valid Liraasa and needs no 'new' flag. Verb class follows the first letter, as for all compounds.
image_compounds.why: 394 dictionary entries followed this exact pattern. Listing them added size but no expressive power, and implied that unlisted pairs (moonlit voice, rain-washed promise) were less valid. As a pattern, all 57 x 31 = 1,767 pairs are available.

reserved_root_bank.note: Short two-syllable roots (consonant-vowel-consonant-vowel) that still fit every rule: at least two edits from every active word in 1.2 plus this patch, and from each other. The most singable root shape is nearly full, so spend these deliberately: on frequent concepts whose words are long. Unassigned; not part of the language until you give one a meaning. Checked against every Liraasa word in the 1.2 file (headwords, forms, small words, numbers, colours, example sentences) and in this patch. Roots with c are left out because its pronunciation is not fixed in the sound section.
